messages.subject: Your Porn Fetch license
messages.body:
Your license file {filename} is attached. Save it and import it in Porn Fetch’s license activation screen.

Use Premium on up to ten installations, in versions released within one year of first activation. Premium remains available in those versions afterwards; later releases require renewal. App updates are free. Activation and periodic validation are required.

Paid through Patreon? Cancel your membership after the first successful payment to avoid further charges. Your issued license remains valid.
